policy.store: individual source-stated financial facts with a citation and a short DISI paraphrase (<= 400 characters); never publisher text
never_store: values derived by DISI without a stated rule
salary, contract guarantees, options, buyouts or agent pay
policy.pages_read: Each new page was fetched once, returned HTTP 200 with the article text and was parsed directly. The two 2016 / 2018 Baseball America reviews were re-read from the copies fetched for Migration 027. No paywall, bot protection or HTTP restriction was bypassed. MLB.com pages answered HTTP 406 and were not used as new evidence.
policy.precision_rule: A figure printed with every digit ("$700,000", "$5,146,200") is EXACT. A figure printed in rounded form is ROUNDED with the precision of its last stated digit: "$12 million" -> 1,000,000; "$6.5 million" / "$6.5MM" / "$25.7 million" -> 100,000; "$5.1462MM" -> 100. A figure the source computes from a stated rule ("25% of his bonus, so $1.625 million") is RULE_DERIVED with its rate and base. "Approximately" is APPROXIMATE and never selects a canonical value.

SIGNING_BONUS: An international amateur signing is paid as a signing bonus; its amount is the acquisition cost.
POSTING_FEE: Amateurs are not posted by a professional club.
TRANSFER_FEE: No professional club holds the amateur's rights.
RELEASE_FEE: No professional club holds the amateur's rights.
OTHER_ACQUISITION_FEE: No other acquisition payment applies to an amateur signing.

SIGNING_BONUS: Cuban professionals signed by the Dodgers received a signing bonus; it is the main acquisition cost.
POSTING_FEE: No posting system applies to Cuban players.
TRANSFER_FEE: No club is paid for a Cuban defector's rights.
RELEASE_FEE: Applies only if a source reports a payment to release the player; it does not block completeness.
OTHER_ACQUISITION_FEE: Applies only if a source reports another acquisition payment; it does not block completeness.

SIGNING_BONUS: A professional free agent may or may not receive a separate signing bonus; when unknown, completeness is PARTIAL.
POSTING_FEE: Applies only when the player was posted; a non-posted free agent has none.
TRANSFER_FEE: A free agent's rights are not sold.
RELEASE_FEE: Applies only if a source reports a release payment.
OTHER_ACQUISITION_FEE: Applies only if a source reports another acquisition payment.

SIGNING_BONUS: A posted player's contract may include a signing bonus; when unknown, completeness is PARTIAL.
POSTING_FEE: Signing a posted player requires a payment to the releasing club; its amount follows the posting rules in force.
TRANSFER_FEE: The posting fee is the payment to the releasing club.
RELEASE_FEE: The posting fee is the payment to the releasing club.
OTHER_ACQUISITION_FEE: Applies only if a source reports another acquisition payment.

SIGNING_BONUS: A player bought from a Mexican League club may also receive a bonus; when unknown, completeness is PARTIAL.
POSTING_FEE: The payment to the Mexican League club is a transfer fee, not a posting fee.
TRANSFER_FEE: The Mexican League club is paid for the player's rights.
RELEASE_FEE: The transfer fee is the payment to the club.
OTHER_ACQUISITION_FEE: Applies only if a source reports another acquisition payment.

SIGNING_BONUS: OTHER is a catch-all pathway; no component rule is defined, so completeness is NO_RULE.
POSTING_FEE: No component rule is defined for OTHER.
TRANSFER_FEE: No component rule is defined for OTHER.
RELEASE_FEE: No component rule is defined for OTHER.
OTHER_ACQUISITION_FEE: No component rule is defined for OTHER.
